cinematic_dialogue:1:1560225001:.text: Chippy has a bad feeling about this!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1560225001:.source_cn: 那家伙，有股可疑的气息！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1560225002:.text: These changes... must be because of the golem.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1560225002:.source_cn: 环境的变化，似乎和它有关

cinematic_dialogue:1:1560225003:.text: We have to beat it to find a way out!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1560225003:.source_cn: 只有打败它才能找到出口！
